title: Coin Change
statement:
coins is a list of distinct positive coin values, and you have unlimited coins of each value. Return the fewest coins needed to make exactly amount, or -1 if it is impossible. amount 0 needs 0 coins.

Example: coins = [1,2,5], amount = 11 -> 3 (5+5+1)
Example: coins = [2], amount = 3 -> -1
